command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj P1.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: First instruction is emitted by llvm-mc (`movq %rbx, %rax` -> 48 89 d8). The second is the 8B /r encoding of the same move, which llvm-mc will not select from a mnemonic; its bytes are verified by `llvm-mc -disassemble`, which prints `movq %rbx, %rax`.
